g.text: Ctrl+\ alone opens the Menu; Ctrl+\ Ctrl+\ sends Ctrl+\ to the session.
Ctrl+] detaches the front session from the canvas and from the lists; Ctrl+\ F1 sends F1 to
Ctrl+\ w Who's here… who types; hand off, take, put aside
Ctrl+\ r Size… the target's size · ask for my size · auto size
Ctrl+\ R Auto size on or off ask for my window's size when it changes, while I type
Ctrl+\ x End session… ends it for everyone; asks first
Ctrl+\ y Answer the question… the session asked whether to kill it: keep it or kill it
— New session on this connection reuse this session's authentication
Ctrl+\ f Targets and sessions open or close the panel beside the terminal
Ctrl+\ F Full view every session you own or may join, full screen
Ctrl+\ t Take back… the keyboard, in a session of yours someone else types in
Ctrl+\ n New session… on a target you can open
Ctrl+\ s Switch to… pick a session from the side panel, or its number after
Ctrl+\ → Next open session the next session open here
Ctrl+\ ← Previous open session the previous session open here
Ctrl+\ h Event log what this session's frames told this client, newest last
Ctrl+\ [ Scroll back older output this client holds; Esc returns to live
Ctrl+\ v Pan move the window over a bigger grid with the arrow keys
Ctrl+\ T Theme… chrome and terminal colours, previewed as you move
— Settings… the knobs in force and where each came from
Ctrl+\ ? All keys every action's key
No live sessions · n new session
